integrity: Exact semilinear Cartier calculations prove the theorem in all algebraically closed fields of characteristic 5. The finite-field verifier is a corroboration, not an infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns coefficient-marked smooth parameters over algebraically closed characteristic-five fields.
No full Newton polygon, Ekedahl–Oort type, rank-divisor multiplicities, or abstract isomorphism-class count is claimed.
An unindexed earlier equivalent calculation remains possible.
title: Six geometric 5-rank-zero Prym fourfolds in a characteristic-five cyclic-trigonal pencil
